title: Immunostimulatory effects mechanism of polysaccharide extracted from Acanthopanax senticosus on RAW 264.7 cells through activating the TLR/MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Wang, Yufan; Wang, Lei; Zhang, Hanwen; Ren, Peirou; Cheng, Xiaowen; Hong, Fandi; Liu, Jiaxin; Zhang, Ruining; Zhao, Jun; Gou, Dongxia
one_liner_zh: 研究刺五加多糖通过TLR/MAPK/NF-kB通路激活巨噬细胞的免疫调节机制，虽含分子对接但对象为多糖-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acanthopanax senticosus is a unique wild resource in Northeast China. Its main active ingredient is a polysaccharide, which has a prominent immunomodulatory effect. In this study, the purified polysaccharide component of Acanthopanax senticosus leaves(ASPS-A1) with strong immunomodulatory activity was isolated by column chromatography, and its structure and properties were characterized by HPGPC, and FT-IR. Results showed that ASPS-A1 is mainly composed of alpha- 1,4-(D)-GalA, alpha- 1,5-(L)-Ara, and beta- 1,4-(D)-Gal. RT-qPCR experiments and RNA-seq analysis were used to study the immunoregulatory mechanism of ASPS-A1. The results showed that ASPS-A1 could significantly up-regulate the levels of cytokines iNOS, IL- 1beta, IL- 6, and TNF-alpha activated macrophages through MAPK, NF-kappaB, and Toll-like receptor signaling pathways. Inhibitory experiments further confirmed that ASPS-A1 promotes the expression of iNOS, TNF-alpha, and IL- 6 via the TLR4 receptor, and TNF-alpha and IL- 1beta via the TLR2 receptor. In order to identify the target of ASPS-A1, molecular docking experiments were conducted. The results demonstrated that ASPS-A1 could bind to both TLR4 and TLR2, forming stable complexes with the cavities on the protein surface through hydrogen bonding and hydrophobic interaction. The docking scores indicated that ASPS-A1 could regulate the immune response through TLR2 and TLR4 signaling pathways, with a particularly strong interaction with TLR4. In summary, this study screened and characterized the most immunoreactive components of Acanthopanax senticosus polysaccharide, disclosed the immunomodulatory mechanism of ASPS-A1, and furnished a research basis for its potential application as a natural immune enhancer.
abstract_zh: 刺五加（Acanthopanax senticosus）是中国东北地区特有的野生资源，其主要活性成分为多糖，具有显著的免疫调节作用。本研究通过柱色谱法分离出具有强免疫调节活性的刺五加叶纯化多糖组分（ASPS-A1），并利用HPGPC和FT-IR对其结构与性质进行了表征。结果表明，ASPS-A1主要由α-1,4-(D)-GalA、α-1,5-(L)-Ara和β-1,4-(D)-Gal组成。采用RT-qPCR实验和RNA-seq分析研究ASPS-A1的免疫调节机制，结果显示，ASPS-A1能显著上调活化巨噬细胞中细胞因子iNOS、IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的水平，并通过MAPK、NF-κB和Toll样受体信号通路发挥作用。抑制实验进一步证实，ASPS-A1通过TLR4受体促进iNOS、TNF-α和IL-6的表达，并通过TLR2受体促进TNF-α和IL-1β的表达。为鉴定ASPS-A1的靶点，进行了分子对接实验。结果表明，ASPS-A1能与TLR4和TLR2结合，通过氢键和疏水相互作用与蛋白质表面的空腔形成稳定复合物。对接评分显示，ASPS-A1可通过TLR2和TLR4信号通路调节免疫反应，其中与TLR4的相互作用尤为强烈。综上所述，本研究筛选并表征了刺五加多糖中免疫活性最强的组分，揭示了ASPS-A1的免疫调节机制，并为其作为天然免疫增强剂的潜在应用提供了研究基础。
